members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both fix malformed OAuth discovery well-known paths caused by trailing-slash handling in buildWellKnownPath(). #2214 only strips repeated trailing slashes from the pathname (regex `/\/+$/`) in both buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls. #2215 makes the same trailing-slash fix but factors it into a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper that also collapses a root path to the empty string, and it additionally fixes shouldAttemptFallback (which still compared against the literal '/' and would misbehave once root paths normalize to ''), a follow-on bug from the same normalization change that #2214 leaves unaddressed.
